## Test shot retrieval (hardcoded player ID)

```{r}
# LeBron James player ID = 2544 (hardcoded to bypass get_player_id)
player_id <- id
season_str <- "2018-19"

resp <- httr::GET(
  "https://stats.nba.com/stats/shotchartdetail",
  query = list(
    PlayerID       = player_id,
    Season         = season_str,
    SeasonType     = "Regular Season",
    TeamID         = 0, GameID        = "",
    ContextMeasure = "FGA",
    DateFrom       = "", DateTo        = "",
    GameSegment    = "", LastNGames    = 0,
    LeagueID       = "00", Location   = "",
    Month          = 0, OpponentTeamID = 0,
    Outcome        = "", Period        = 0,
    Position       = "", RookieYear    = "",
    SeasonSegment  = "", VsConference  = "",
    VsDivision     = ""
  ),
  httr::add_headers(
    `User-Agent`         = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    `Referer`            = "https://www.nba.com/",
    `Origin`             = "https://www.nba.com",
    `x-nba-stats-origin` = "stats",
    `x-nba-stats-token`  = "true",
    `Accept`             = "application/json, text/plain, */*",
    `Accept-Language`    = "en-US,en;q=0.9",
    `Connection`         = "keep-alive"
  ),
  httr::timeout(30)
)

cat("HTTP status:", httr::status_code(resp), "\n")
```

```{r}
# parse only if request succeeded
parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr::content(resp, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
hdrs   <- parsed$resultSets$headers[[1]]
rows   <- parsed$resultSets$rowSet[[1]]
raw    <- as.data.frame(rows, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(raw) <- hdrs
cat("Rows retrieved:", nrow(raw), "\n")
head(raw[, c("PLAYER_NAME", "GAME_ID", "GAME_DATE", "LOC_X", "LOC_Y", "SHOT_MADE_FLAG")])
```

## Test nba_data

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr) # sudo apt-get install liblapack-dev libblas-dev gfortran
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(BasketballAnalyzeR)

library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(transport)
library(curveDepth)
```

```{r}
source("../R/nba-functions.R") #add echo = T to see more details ##Rudy Gobert 
shots <- nba_data(Player = "Bam Adebayo", season = 2019)
#str(shots)
head(shots)
data = nba_data_depth(shots)
p_made = nba_data_depth_made(data)
p_missed = nba_data_depth_missed(data)
curNdirs <- 250
figure <- ddplot_nba(p_missed, p_made,Ndirs = curNdirs,
                  parConst1 = -2, parConst2 = 5) 
deepestx <- order(figure$XvsX) ; 
deepesty <- order(figure$YvsY) ; 
plot(figure$YvsY[deepesty],type='h',main="Marked Shots")
plot(figure$XvsX[deepestx],type='h',main="Missed Shots")
```


```{r}
# --- joueurs et saisons ------------------------------------------------------
players <- c("Bam Adebayo", "Giannis Antetokounmpo","stephen curry")
seasons <- c(2019,2019,2019)
# --- calcul des profondeurs par joueur ---------------------------------------
depths_by_player <- lapply(seq_along(players), function(i) {
  cat(sprintf("Processing %s (season %d) ...\n", players[i], seasons[i]))
  shots  <- nba_data(Player = players[i], season = seasons[i])
  data   <- nba_data_depth(shots)
  depths <- depth_all_matches(
    matches   = data,
    Ndirs     = 250,
    parConst1 = -1,
    parConst2 = 5,
    package   = TRUE
  )
  depths
})

# labels <- paste0(players, "\n(", seasons, ")")
labels <- paste0(players)
names(depths_by_player) <- labels

```

```{r}
# --- visualisation -----------------------------------------------------------
# postscript("../figures/boxplot.eps",
#            horizontal = FALSE,

par(mar = c(4, 4, 0.2, 0.2))
boxplot(depths_by_player,
       # col     = c("steelblue", "firebrick", "gold", "seagreen"),
        ylab    = "Tukey depth",

# dev.off()
```

```{r}
})
```

```{r}
# postscript("../figures/deepest_matches.eps",
#            horizontal = FALSE,
#            onefile    = FALSE,
#            paper      = "special",
#            width      = 15,
#            height     = 10)
  library(patchwork)
  
  title_theme <- theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, vjust = 0))
  
  p1 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[1]], depths_by_player[[1]], no = 1) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[1]) + title_theme
  p2 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[2]], depths_by_player[[2]], no = 1) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[2]) + title_theme
  p3 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[3]], depths_by_player[[3]], no = 1) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[3]) + title_theme
  
  n1 <- length(data_by_player[[1]])
  n2 <- length(data_by_player[[2]])
  n3 <- length(data_by_player[[3]])
  
  p4 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[1]], depths_by_player[[1]], no = n1) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[1]) + title_theme
  p5 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[2]], depths_by_player[[2]], no = n2) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[2]) + title_theme
  p6 <- plot_deepest_match(data_by_player[[3]], depths_by_player[[3]], no = n3) + ggtitle(names(data_by_player)[3]) + title_theme
  
  (p1 | p2 | p3) / (p4 | p5 | p6) 
#dev.off()
```
